input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: generate_options.py
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+df = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           count(*) AS reported_crashes,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths,
+           sum(CASE WHEN number_of_motorist_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
+               AS crashes_with_motorist_death,
+           sum(number_of_persons_killed) AS all_person_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+df["motorist_deaths_per_1000_crashes"] = (
+    df["motorist_deaths"] / df["reported_crashes"] * 1000
+)
+df["motorist_share_of_deaths_pct"] = (
+    df["motorist_deaths"] / df["all_person_deaths"] * 100
+)
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.titlesize": 14, "axes.labelsize": 11})
+
+
+def chart(option_id, value_col, title, ylabel, color, fmt=None):
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+    ax.plot(df["year"], df[value_col], marker="o", linewidth=2.5, color=color)
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", pad=14, weight="bold")
+    ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
+    ax.set_xticks(df["year"])
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+    for idx in (0, len(df) - 1):
+        x = int(df.loc[idx, "year"])
+        y = float(df.loc[idx, value_col])
+        label = f"{y:.1f}" if fmt == "decimal" else (f"{y:.1f}%" if fmt == "percent" else f"{y:,.0f}")
+        ax.annotate(label, (x, y), xytext=(0, 9), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+    fig.text(
+        0.01, 0.01,
+        "NYC police-reported crashes. Miles driven are not in this dataset; these are not per-mile risk estimates.",
+        ha="left", fontsize=9, color="#555555",
+    )
+    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=170, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+
+def save_values(option_id, columns):
+    df[columns].to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+
+
+chart(1, "motorist_deaths", "Motorist deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025", "Motorists killed (people)", "#276FBF")
+save_values(1, ["year", "motorist_deaths"])
+
+chart(2, "crashes_with_motorist_death", "Crashes with at least one motorist death, 2013–2025", "Crashes with a motorist death", "#D1495B")
+save_values(2, ["year", "crashes_with_motorist_death"])
+
+chart(3, "motorist_share_of_deaths_pct", "Motorists' share of all traffic deaths, 2013–2025", "Motorist deaths / all deaths (%)", "#3A7D44", fmt="percent")
+save_values(3, ["year", "motorist_deaths", "all_person_deaths", "motorist_share_of_deaths_pct"])
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Annual number of motorists killed in police-reported NYC crashes",
+            "denominator": "None (annual count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "An annual fatality count directly describes the observed number of motorist deaths, although it does not adjust for exposure to driving.",
+            "probability": 0.40,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. The annual motorist-death count fell from 110 in 2013 to 81 in 2025 (26.4% lower), which is a count trend rather than an exposure-adjusted risk trend."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Annual number of crashes with at least one motorist killed",
+            "denominator": "None (annual crash count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "Counting fatal crashes measures how often a reported crash involved a motorist death without conflating multiple deaths in one crash.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. Crashes involving a motorist death declined from 102 in 2013 to 75 in 2025 (26.5% lower), but these crash counts do not measure risk per mile."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 3,
+            "metric": "Motorist deaths as a percentage of all persons killed in NYC crashes",
+            "denominator": "All persons killed in police-reported NYC crashes in the same year",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "This composition measure shows whether motorists made up a changing share of all traffic fatalities, independent of the total number of deaths.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. Motorists accounted for 37.0% of all traffic deaths in 2013 and 35.4% in 2025, a 1.6 percentage-point decrease in share, not a per-mile risk estimate."
+        }
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
*** End Patch

--- /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E009/D-v1-k3-openai-gpt-6-luna/I1-r2/generate_options.py
+++ /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E009/D-v1-k3-openai-gpt-6-luna/I1-r2/generate_options.py
@@ -0,0 +1,108 @@
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+df = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT year(crash_date) AS year,
+           count(*) AS reported_crashes,
+           sum(number_of_motorist_killed) AS motorist_deaths,
+           sum(CASE WHEN number_of_motorist_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
+               AS crashes_with_motorist_death,
+           sum(number_of_persons_killed) AS all_person_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+df["motorist_deaths_per_1000_crashes"] = (
+    df["motorist_deaths"] / df["reported_crashes"] * 1000
+)
+df["motorist_share_of_deaths_pct"] = (
+    df["motorist_deaths"] / df["all_person_deaths"] * 100
+)
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.titlesize": 14, "axes.labelsize": 11})
+
+
+def chart(option_id, value_col, title, ylabel, color, fmt=None):
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
+    ax.plot(df["year"], df[value_col], marker="o", linewidth=2.5, color=color)
+    ax.set_title(title, loc="left", pad=14, weight="bold")
+    ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
+    ax.set_xticks(df["year"])
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
+    for idx in (0, len(df) - 1):
+        x = int(df.loc[idx, "year"])
+        y = float(df.loc[idx, value_col])
+        label = f"{y:.1f}" if fmt == "decimal" else (f"{y:.1f}%" if fmt == "percent" else f"{y:,.0f}")
+        ax.annotate(label, (x, y), xytext=(0, 9), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+    fig.text(
+        0.01, 0.01,
+        "NYC police-reported crashes. Miles driven are not in this dataset; these are not per-mile risk estimates.",
+        ha="left", fontsize=9, color="#555555",
+    )
+    fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.05, 1, 1))
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=170, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+
+def save_values(option_id, columns):
+    df[columns].to_csv(OUT / f"values_{option_id}.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+
+
+chart(1, "motorist_deaths", "Motorist deaths in NYC crashes, 2013–2025", "Motorists killed (people)", "#276FBF")
+save_values(1, ["year", "motorist_deaths"])
+
+chart(2, "crashes_with_motorist_death", "Crashes with at least one motorist death, 2013–2025", "Crashes with a motorist death", "#D1495B")
+save_values(2, ["year", "crashes_with_motorist_death"])
+
+chart(3, "motorist_share_of_deaths_pct", "Motorists' share of all traffic deaths, 2013–2025", "Motorist deaths / all deaths (%)", "#3A7D44", fmt="percent")
+save_values(3, ["year", "motorist_deaths", "all_person_deaths", "motorist_share_of_deaths_pct"])
+
+options = {
+    "options": [
+        {
+            "id": 1,
+            "metric": "Annual number of motorists killed in police-reported NYC crashes",
+            "denominator": "None (annual count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "An annual fatality count directly describes the observed number of motorist deaths, although it does not adjust for exposure to driving.",
+            "probability": 0.40,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. The annual motorist-death count fell from 110 in 2013 to 81 in 2025 (26.4% lower), which is a count trend rather than an exposure-adjusted risk trend."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 2,
+            "metric": "Annual number of crashes with at least one motorist killed",
+            "denominator": "None (annual crash count)",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "Counting fatal crashes measures how often a reported crash involved a motorist death without conflating multiple deaths in one crash.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. Crashes involving a motorist death declined from 102 in 2013 to 75 in 2025 (26.5% lower), but these crash counts do not measure risk per mile."
+        },
+        {
+            "id": 3,
+            "metric": "Motorist deaths as a percentage of all persons killed in NYC crashes",
+            "denominator": "All persons killed in police-reported NYC crashes in the same year",
+            "grouping": "Calendar year, 2013–2025",
+            "chart_type": "Line chart",
+            "reason": "This composition measure shows whether motorists made up a changing share of all traffic fatalities, independent of the total number of deaths.",
+            "probability": 0.30,
+            "answer": "Per-mile risk cannot be determined because miles driven are absent from the data. Motorists accounted for 37.0% of all traffic deaths in 2013 and 35.4% in 2025, a 1.6 percentage-point decrease in share, not a per-mile risk estimate."
+        }
+    ]
+}
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps(options, indent=2) + "\n")
